title: About LBS College of Engineering
text: LBS College of Engineering was started in 1993 under the auspices of LBS Centre for Science and Technology, Thiruvananthapuram, an autonomous body owned by the Government of Kerala. The campus is at Povval in Muliyar Panchayath, Kasaragod district, and covers 52 acres.

title: Programmes
text: The programmes page lists undergraduate programmes in Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science), Computer Science and Business Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, and Civil Engineering. It also lists an M.Tech in Computer Science and Information Security.

title: Departments
text: The departments page lists Computer Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Applied Science, and Physical Education.

title: Contact Us
text: LBS College of Engineering is located at Povval, Muliyar Post Office, Kasaragod, Kerala-671542. The college contact numbers listed are 04994 250290 and 04994 250555. The principal email listed is principal@lbscek.ac.in.

title: Career Guidance Cell
text: The Career Guidance Cell provides learning and training opportunities for academic, career, personal, and social development. Its listed activities include campus-interview preparation, job-placement support, workshops and seminars on personality development, communication, interview and presentation skills, competitive-exam diagnostic tests, higher-studies guidance, and orientation programmes for freshers.
